notes.title: RedDeer.Games presents a new, cozy, puzzle game - Tell Me Your Story 📖
notes.content:
RedDeer.Games announces developement of a new in house game - Tell Me Your Story - proposition for every fan of story-driven, cozy & puzzle games! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/9740fd7b2d093f1a8556098e40c9e72dc7fbff67.jpg

Amelia comes to her grandma's cottage for the summer, expecting to spend the warm months there knitting, gardening, and helping her out. Soon enough, the girl realizes that her grandma Rose's house is full of wonders, artifacts, and souvenirs from all around the world. 

And so begins a journey to the past via the tales and memories of a retired globetrotter – a side of Amelia’s grandma, that she had no idea about.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/5a0570940adae65b57d63025550b2a9dbeed5c45.jpg

In Tell Me Your Story, the players, together with Amelia, will be tasked with helping the elderly woman with everyday chores – that is until they will find a couple of interesting artifacts. 

This discovery will turn the summer vacation around and Rose's adventurous past will be unearthed in the form of colorful memories.

To follow the story, the players will solve region-themed puzzles, surrounded by the hand-drawn scenery. There will be over 70 different types of riddles, neatly separated into 3 chapters related to Rose’s travels. Visiting South America's rainforests, the Chinese province of Yunnan, and the track of Orient Express' first route – that’s what players can expect.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/3f66393b0ce00aee6bc61123985dcbc72e205ea4.jpg

Tell Me Your Story has eye-catching and cozy visuals, that fit perfectly with the theme of getting to know the past of one's family. Those tales will be powered by Amelia's vivid imagination – which conveys the wordless game’s story perfectly.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42267264/bdafd80507fdf0732489c23bdcd9e671afc91026.gif
Tell Me Your Story will be available on Steam and Nintendo Switch in 2024

You can wishlist the game now! 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415570/Tell_me_your_story/?beta=0

notes.title: The game is now available on Steam
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/c5c8e45f08cdf52cabb232e05b35723cf09113bd.png

Hello Players,

We are thrilled to announce that our game GardenBuddies has finally been released, and the wait is over! After countless hours of hard work and dedication from our two-person development team, we are delighted to present you with a captivating and heartwarming gaming experience. GardenBuddies invites you to immerse yourself in a tranquil oasis of vibrant flowers, adorable animal companions, and engaging gameplay. Whether you are a seasoned gardener or a casual player looking for a soothing escape, our game offers something special for everyone. Join us now and embark on a journey of friendship, discovery, and inner peace as you cultivate your virtual garden and form bonds with charming critters. We can't wait for you to experience the magic of GardenBuddies and create your own peaceful sanctuary within the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/68ba25b14a7809709098e0e547a7ae9390eccff0.jpg

Are you ready to escape to a world where tranquility and companionship flourish? GardenBuddies awaits you with its enchanting narratives, heartwarming interactions, and delightful twists that unfold in the 90-minute story mode. Immerse yourself in the soothing soundtrack that has been carefully crafted for relaxation and harmony. But GardenBuddies is more than just a game; it's a healing experience for your mind, introducing essential life skills such as mindfulness exercises, stress reduction techniques, and emotional well-being practices. Embrace the therapeutic power of gardening and let our game guide you towards inner peace and emotional balance. As a two-person team, we poured our hearts into creating GardenBuddies, and we sincerely hope you find joy and solace in this labor of love. Join us in this tranquil journey and explore the magical world that awaits in GardenBuddies today!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/73487d32007bb2b631dcffcd06e6cf75e6037edb.jpg

Thank you for your support and presence in this incredible journey!

Warm regards,
The "GardenBuddies" Team

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Welcome to the Garden of Dreams!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/111f09f61eb9463f92ded6a78dfcb3d6c389b94a.png

Hello Players,

With immense joy, we welcome you to the first devlog of our game GardenBuddies! 
Introducing you to this magical world filled with flowers and adorable creatures is an exceptional pleasure for us. This is an incredibly exciting moment, and we can't wait to share the behind-the-scenes of the game's development with you. Creating the mysterious and soothing world of Garden Buddies was not an easy or quick task. It required time, dedication, and passion to weave together emotions and the beauty of nature seamlessly. We encountered challenges, explored various concepts, and transformed ideas into reality, ensuring every aspect of the game reflected our vision. However, we believe the effort was worthwhile, as the final result allows you to embark on a unique journey of discovery, learning, and inner peace.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/d6954a8b573a9af19b2776542f64127deea61f39.png

The culmination of our efforts, GardenBuddies, is a realization of our dream and a deep expression of our love for games, nature, and emotional experiences. It's a delightful adventure that immerses you in a world of vibrant flowers and charming animals while imparting knowledge about stress management and emotional well-being. We are thrilled to share this special game with you, and we can't wait to witness your reactions and experiences as you explore this enchanting Garden of Dreams!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/dd275be117320cd905d0a5cdffc39206dcd46bcb.png
(Old & New Musty)

Thank you for your support and presence in this incredible journey!

Warm regards,
The "GardenBuddies" Team

notes.title: Cozy adventure – Garden Buddies – has received a release date!
notes.content:
Step into a wonderful plant oasis, to make beautiful friendships and heal your tired mind. This unique blend of cozy gardening simulator and mental self-care experience will be available for Steam and Nintendo Switch players on October 20! 

In Garden Buddies, a unique gardening simulator, players will find themselves in the middle of a fairytale world. Together with their new friend, the little apple-like creature Mutsy, they will begin an adventure to not only build the garden of their dreams but also to mentally respite.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/323e6e073f89b254ab2308a9f9ffd1e6e3cb61a8.jpg

In the heartwarming story, players accompanied by Mutsy, will explore the magical world, creating and building their plant sanctuary. The relaxing storyline will be filled with uplifting narration, as well as unexpected twists and turns.

Above all, however, players will make new friendships with the animals and plant creatures they encounter. As good friends, they will help new companions overcome the various obstacles and problems they face, and all this in the form of engaging mini-games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/71ce7f307dde7cf203ba1a601e04e5ae61758b46.jpg

The players can take a step back from the stress of every day life and let the companions guide them towards their own mental oasis. With the lovely mini-games and chances to decorate personal space – unwinding is guaranteed.

On top of the relaxing atmosphere and beautiful, digital nature, Garden Buddies offers breathing and grounding techniques that help with everyday anxiety. Through this, the players will experience less stress not only during their playtime, but also learn how to overcome stressful obstacles away from their devices.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/3b97a441411d97a74c5a690794366d964781f8bd.jpg

Garden Buddies will be available for Steam and Nintendo Switch players on October 20!

[previewyoutube=ad2cM-xWkC8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: GardenBuddies x WHOLESOME GAMES
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44182970/ba8a631c72a72da6b436984be5764ed0a91831a0.png

GardenBuddies joins the Wholesome Games event!
[previewyoutube=U-ut5ABVqNY;full][/previewyoutube]

Wholesome Games is a video game curation community with over 500,000 members across social media platforms. The community is best known for Wholesome Direct, a popular showcase of uplifting and thoughtful indie games.

One of the goals of Wholesome Games is to change how we think about which games are taken seriously. For many years, the most critically acclaimed titles have been the ones with the darkest themes and grimmest depictions of life, but there's also a whole world of hopeful video games with rich storytelling, innovative gameplay, and beautiful art and sound. We want to be a part of showcasing the breadth of experiences that games can have for players.

Wholesome Direct is an independent showcase organized by Wholesome Games. Each year the showcase features a selection of indie games that demonstrate the incredible range of themes, styles, and perspectives that games have to offer. Wholesome Direct 2023 will be streamed live on Saturday, June 10 at 9 AM PT via YouTube and Twitch.
